# Valerion’s Blackswords

## **Valerion’s Blackswords**
## **Born in Betrayal**
The Blackswords are a mercenary company, fighting for pay and prisoners across the world. They appear to humans as plain-dressed elves from distant lands, carefully concealing their identity. Given their professional prowess in battle, most patrons overlook their cruelty in combat and demands to take captives away with them. 

Taking his remaining retainers, Valerion fled along the coast until he reached the relative safety of Clar Karond. There on the docks, he signed himself and his men on as mercenaries for _Temple of Spite_ , receiving refuge in return for obedience. Setting sail on a ravenship bound for the ark, he swore never to return to Naggaroth until he had accumulated enough fame and power to take revenge on House Morandor. 

## **Goals**
The Blackswords were once the household guard of House Temendros of Hag Graef, whose dreadlords held exalted positions in the city’s ruling elite. Some even thought the head of the house would one day replace the drachau, and such ambition was their undoing. 

On Death Night, 2290 IC, House Temendros was betrayed by their vassals in House Morandor. As night fell over Hag Graef, prowling witch elves poured into Temendros’ tower through an unlocked door and murdered every living being within in orgiastic worship to Khaine. 

Not all Temendros were present that night. The heir, Valerion Temendros, was with a detachment of household troops sent to punish a reaving clan of shades that were ravaging their rural estates. When word reached him of the perfidy of House Morandor, he knew that flight was his only hope for survival. 

**Wealth, reputation and an exciting life.** For many dark elf mercenaries lust for wealth goes beyond gold, as captives are also valuable. Proving their skill in battle brings status for the Blackswords and deters others from trying to dominate them. 

**Protect Durith Helbane.** The Blackswords gained much from the failed mutiny. They elevated their position in the ark’s hierarchy by persecuting those labelled traitors on behalf of the fleetmaster. This was a calculated move by Valerion and Damina Hroska to raise the Blackswords about other soldiers in the warhost and buy independence from the chain of command. 

**Revenge against House Morandor.** Valerion Temendros wants revenge on those who destroyed his house. The need to wreak terrible retribution consumes his soul. Unlike most Druchii, his patience lasts decades. He bides his time, building his experience, power, and wealth, until he can one day return to Hag Graef and cleanse his ancestral home with Morandor blood.
